name: saqi
description: Arabic poetry corpus, public Astro site, and Cloudflare ingestion workers

scripts.build: yarn build:api && yarn workspace @saqi/source-collector build && yarn workspace @saqi/site build && yarn workspace @saqi/operations build
scripts.fix: yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-iso fix && yarn workspace @saqi/operations fix
scripts.check:built: yarn workspace @saqi/source-collector check::format && yarn workspace @saqi/source-collector check::types && yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-iso check::format && yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-iso check::types && yarn workspace @saqi/operations check::format && yarn workspace @saqi/operations check::types && yarn workspace @saqi/site check
scripts.test: yarn build:api && yarn workspace @saqi/source-collector test && yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-iso test && yarn workspace @saqi/operations test && yarn workspace @saqi/site test
scripts.test:built: yarn workspace @saqi/source-collector test && yarn workspace @saqi/precedent-iso test && yarn workspace @saqi/operations test && yarn workspace @saqi/site test:built
scripts.clean: yarn workspaces foreach -Avp run clean && yarn clean::deps
scripts.setup:standards: uvx --no-config --isolated --python 3.14 --from code-standards==8.113.0 code-standards show config eslint | xargs -I{} cp {} eslint.strict.ts
